canonical_stable.scope: Only verified stable release in athNdev/carbonpanel. Upstream discopanel has many released stable tags with five assets each; they are upstream component history and are never promoted to Carbon Panel aliases.

historical_alias.notes: Planned canonical annotated Git alias at the v1.0.40 peeled commit. Resolves to the original release; creates no second GitHub release. Refused as a new release candidate at the publication policy boundary, before registry preflight.

rollback_line.notes: 1.0 currently points at 1.0.40 in both registries. A future 1.0.x maintenance patch is not banned; it may move the 1.0 alias only via explicit, monotonic promotion.

rationale: B1 OIDC raw-group roles locked out by default and implicit first-user admin removed
B2 explicit local admin linking required (no implicit admin bootstrap)
B3 PROXY v2 headers trusted only from trusted_proxy_cidrs (default: trust nobody)
